qualityGate: New useful question; primary scientific sources
Subject-specific diagrams and models, no unrelated reused scenes
Original complete narration and readable connected Arabic
Inspect every scene and transitions, including closing
Verify portrait dimensions, actual duration and audio presence
Check caption bounds, sound levels, source speech completeness and audio/video sync
Fix found issues internally before delivery
Check Buffer for duplicate topic/file before publication
